claim: 2a. A 2026 amendment of the Personal Information Protection Act (announced ~March 2026) takes effect 2026-09-11 with a turnover-based penalty surcharge up to 10%.
notes: Act No. 21445 promulgated 2026-03-10; 부칙 art.1: effective 6 months after promulgation (2026-09-11), except 32-2(1) proviso and 75(2)15 on 2027-07-01. New Art. 64-2(2) allows up to 10% of total turnover only for: repeat intentional/grossly negligent breach within 3 years; intentional/gross-negligence breach affecting 10M+ persons; leak after non-compliance with a corrective order. The general cap in 64-2(1) is 3% (unchanged). Decree No. 36671 (promulgated 2026-09-10) effective 2026-09-11 adds mitigation for prevention investment (up to 40% of base amount) and 'leak possibility' notice. Decree No. 36340 (2026-05-19) changed the revenue base. 'Announced around March 2026' is consistent with the promulgation date 2026-03-10; the National Assembly passage date was not checked (UNVERIFIED). News pages were not used.
